title: linux: fix intermittent connection resets behind a load balancer
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Connessioni resettate in modo intermittente dietro un load balancer. Individua idle-timeout/keepalive mismatch tra LB e backend e stabilizza. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix intermittent connection resets behind a load balancer

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'fix intermittent connection resets behind a load balancer'
expected_reasoning: Intermittent RSTs behind an LB usually mean an idle-timeout/keepalive mismatch between LB and backend.
Compare the LB idle timeout with the backend keepalive; the shorter side silently drops idle conns.
Align keepalive < LB idle timeout on the backend; verify no resets on long-lived connections.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix intermittent connection resets behind a load balancer
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix intermittent connection resets behind a load balancer' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix intermittent connection resets behind a load balancer

possible_mistakes: Blame the app for RSTs caused by an LB idle timeout.
hints: Backend keepalive must be shorter than the LB idle timeout.
The RST comes from whichever side times out first.
reference_solution: Compare LB idle vs backend keepalive
Verify no resets on idle-then-active conns
alternative_solution: Enable TCP keepalives end to end so idle connections stay warm.
edge_cases: A stateful firewall between LB and backend has its own idle timeout.
goal: Connessioni resettate in modo intermittente dietro un load balancer. Individua idle-timeout/keepalive mismatch tra LB e backend e stabilizza.
